discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind inspection of a newly discovered immutable public benchmark corpus with committed per-task run directories, aggregate CSVs, runner, verification procedure, isolation configuration and blind quality-tournament artifacts. Admission is restricted to the six source-declared same-model default-mode pairs over the common 15-task test surface; outcome direction was not used to select pairs.

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The forced-high Codex batches are explicit reasoning-effort interventions rather than the default-mode pair surface admitted here. They remain public candidate evidence for a separate control/ablation treatment and are not silently merged with the default-mode observations.

The pairwise tournament is fully inspectable but its unit is a blind pairwise quality duel with repeated judge passes rather than the per-system aggregate test-outcome unit admitted in this checkpoint. It should be represented under an explicit pairwise-quality evidence design rather than collapsed into the test-pass record.

The repository exposes comparison infrastructure and runtime leaderboard/voting logic, but W1 did not identify a committed immutable result snapshot at the inspected revision. README/runtime claims alone were not promoted to a neutral empirical observation.
